name: com.palavue/county-economy-bundle
description: U.S. county measures for workplaces, jobs, pay, and local comparisons.

tools.name: search_counties
tools.description: Find counties by name or state. Free. Returns FIPS codes; no values.

tools.name: get_catalog
tools.description: Edition, the three plans (pay once, subscribe, on demand), prices and each plan's limits. Free.

tools.name: get_measure_definitions
tools.description: What every measure means: question, unit, periods, what a blank means. Free.

tools.name: quote_order
tools.description: Price of a plan: once (the full edition), subscription (monthly, updated on the feed) or ondemand (an add-on: pay as you go per county record, billed monthly, no cap; nothing is charged to start). Every plan covers every county. Free. Does not buy anything. The answer includes cart_url: the page with the plan chosen, for a person to review and pay.

tools.name: get_county
tools.description: All measures for one county, or only the ones listed in metrics (a county is still one record). Requires an API key and a plan (a payment_required error otherwise).

metrics.description: Optional. Return only these measure ids (see get_measure_definitions), for example ["NC05","DC-01"]. A county is still one record.

tools.name: get_counties
tools.description: Request any counties by list (fips), by state, or all of them (all=true), one page at a time (at most 100 a page). Pass after=<next> from the previous page until next is null. Optional metrics limits each county to those measure ids (a county is still one record). Requires an API key and a plan.

metrics.description: Optional. Return only these measure ids (see get_measure_definitions), for example ["NC05","DC-01"]. A county is still one record.

tools.name: get_feed_updates
tools.description: The edition and data revision you are on now, with the date and plain release notes of the latest revision. Pass since=<revision id such as 2026-11-04.r6, or an edition id> to see whether values changed since then: a revision can change values inside the same edition. Subscribers and on-demand customers receive revisions automatically. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Plan, limits, orders, subscriptions and the last day of usage. Requires an API key.

tools.name: get_spend_controls
tools.description: Your on-demand spend cap, alert thresholds and notification settings. No cap unless you set one. Requires an API key.

tools.name: set_spend_controls
tools.description: On demand only. cap_usd stops requests (402 spend_cap_reached) once this billing period's usage would pass it (null removes the cap); alert_usd and alert_percents create notifications; webhook_url and email are optional. Only send what you want to change. Ask the person before setting or removing a cap.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Alerts about your on-demand spend (thresholds reached, cap reached). Set mark_read=true to mark them read. Requires an API key.
